items.summary: Independent review: reject the candidate plan as submitted. Do not create or expand high-priority queue work, production requests, proposals, telemetry, spending, credentials, schedules, monetization, or launch changes. Preserve only existing execution-reconciliation, failure-containment, measurement, legal-readiness, and private-launch-gate work already in progress. Revenue, ROI, margin, attribution, causal lift, and operational-health claims remain unsupported; the aggregate commission row cannot be assigned to a site. No new research request is defensible because the material evidence gaps are internal telemetry, permissions, configuration, or owner decisions rather than resolvable public facts. Owner message: drain existing failures and measurement backlog, keep gated exposure private, preserve unknowns, and authorize no new queue work until an unblocked candidate has a measurable outcome and documented rollback.
